es.example: En todo caso, te llamo mañana.
es.exampleTranslation: In any case, I'll call you tomorrow.

it.example: In ogni caso, ti chiamo domani.
it.exampleTranslation: In any case, I'll call you tomorrow.

bridge.note: Italian counts cases one by one (ogni), Spanish takes them wholesale (todo) — the same quantifier mirror that shows up wherever the two languages have to choose between counting one by one and taking the whole.

interference.es_to_it: The ogni/toda split again: 'in tutto caso' is not Italian.
interference.it_to_es: 'En cada caso' means literally in each case — the marker is en todo caso.
